description:
## Goal, scope, and overlap
Planning only; no test execution or code changes in this handoff. Parent zaq-xfj; zaq-xfj.1 delivered the typed settings and closed with existing tests, so this is a separate, test-only coverage follow-up. Parent should reconcile parallel coverage plans before assigning implementation. Baseline supplied: lib/zaq/system/web_browsing_config.ex at 90%, missed lines 36, 64, 77. Recheck line mapping after concurrent edits; do not alter production merely to raise a metric.

## Exact authorized edit surface
ONLY edit test/zaq/system/web_browsing_config_test.exs. Reuse its WebBrowsingConfig alias, use Zaq.DataCase, existing ExUnitProperties import, and existing domain-normalization tests. No changes to lib/, test/support/, BO/Playwright tests, documentation, or fixtures. No new mocks. Public changeset/2 and normalize_domains/1 are the test contracts; never call private valid_domain?/1. If the public path cannot exercise a claimed gap, stop and request approval for a production change rather than silently widening scope.

## Test-first scenarios and line mapping
1. Line 36: add a table-driven test for attrs = nil, [] and %WebBrowsingConfig{} passed to WebBrowsingConfig.changeset(%WebBrowsingConfig{}, attrs). Assert invalid? == false and exact {:base, {"invalid settings", []}} in changeset.errors for each. Include a valid-map control (%{allowed_domains: "ZAQ.AI"}) that is valid with canonical "zaq.ai" to prove rejection is limited to non-map/struct inputs. No database, global config, or Ecto internals mocking; an embedded struct is deliberately rejected by the guard.
2. Line 64: exercise WebBrowsingConfig.normalize_domains/1 directly for nil, a number, a list, and a map; assert exactly {:error, :invalid_domains} for each. This proves the fallback public function accepts no nonbinary input, independently of changeset cast. Do not claim an invalid cast reaches line 64: normalize_allowed_domains/1 uses get_field(...) || "", while Ecto cast may reject input earlier.
3. Line 77: build exact-length ASCII DNS hosts from four labels, lengths 63,63,63,61 plus three dots = 253 bytes; then replace final 61-byte label with 62 bytes = 254. Assert {:ok, ^host_253} = normalize_domains(host_253) and {:error, :invalid_domains} = normalize_domains(host_254). Both have individually valid labels so only the total-byte-length guard differs. Also assert the public changeset with %{allowed_domains: host_254} is invalid and contains {:allowed_domains, {"enter comma-separated hostnames", []}}. Optionally add a bounded ExUnitProperties property: generate lengths 1..63 for first three labels and 1..63 for last; whenever total byte size >253, normalize_domains returns the error. This secures a broad guard invariant; keep generation conditioned/bounded to avoid discarded cases and do not duplicate current idempotence property. Prefer concrete 253/254 example as the indispensable boundary regression.

## Isolation and cleanup
Keep scenarios in the existing test module (currently async: false due to database/event/trigger integration tests); these new pure calls neither mutate global environment nor persist rows. Existing Zaq.DataCase sandbox handles any surrounding DB tests; no added setup/on_exit, process, file, app-env, Mox, network, sleep, or polling. Assertions are immediate return values. Do not lower existing assertions or change module-wide isolation as part of this focused task.

## Gates and evidence
Before implementation check current git status/issue overlap and write tests first. Execute isolated `mix test test/zaq/system/web_browsing_config_test.exs` using Context Mode (summarize failures only); then `mix q` via Context Mode per issue validation; inspect diff for test-only scope. Existing policy calls for system-config E2E when configuration behavior changes, but this follow-up adds only unit regression coverage of existing behavior: no new browser spec or UX approval gate. Existing required E2E belongs to parent feature zaq-xfj.7 after zaq-xfj.6 human approval; do not author it here. No full suite or numerical coverage rerun in this planning pass. After implementation and review approval, coverage-upper owns fresh `mix coveralls.json` (600000 ms) and `mix coverup`, then repeat issue checks; final `mix precommit` (900000 ms) before final human approval. Any failing isolated test: diagnose and fix rather than weaken assertion; record infrastructure blockers. Verify all three formerly missed lines against a fresh report only at the authorized coverage phase; report any remaining misses or newly unreachable case with evidence.

## Action reuse assessment
Not applicable: no executable operation changes. Tests call existing WebBrowsingConfig public contracts unchanged; no new Action, workflow step, registry exposure, dispatch, provider mock, or BO path. Existing System grouped configuration integration tests remain untouched. No unreachable supplied line: direct public changeset/2 reaches 36, public normalize_domains/1 reaches 64, and an overlong syntactically valid hostname reaches 77.

comments.text: Execution clarification: include the bounded ExUnitProperties overlength property (not optional): fix first three ASCII labels to 63 bytes each; generate fourth label length in 62..63, giving 254..255 total bytes; assert normalize_domains/1 always returns {:error, :invalid_domains}. Keep the concrete 253/254 boundary test too; no production edits.

Coordinator review complete: exclusive ownership test/zaq/system/web_browsing_config_test.exs. No overlap with other current plans; independent root. Test-only Action reuse N/A.
